result.reason: The redline adopts the preferred 12-month software/Deliverable and 90-day Services periods and expressly preserves correction, replacement, and refund remedies through Section 19.4. However, the supplied operative language does not expressly provide the required professional-and-workmanlike, legal-compliance, or no-malicious-code warranties; the unexplained reference to Section 19.1 is insufficient to establish that those requirements are met. The changes are otherwise targeted and professionally drafted, though the trigger dates for ongoing Services and software not characterized as a Deliverable could be clearer.
